purpose: Frozen seam between the course-media asset manifest (WF12) / course public adapter (WF06) and the Skill-6 native course content binding step (WF08). Consumers: WF07 course coordinator/router, WF06 course adapter, WF12 asset seam.

paths.existing_native_content: Path A - verified same-location native content ID of the right type is attached through the documented lesson operation, then content readback/playback is verified.
paths.public_import: Path B - documented course import for a compatible NEW hierarchy; never mixed with individual creates.
paths.managed_native_ui: Path C - managed browser fills only the missing native-content step on API-created course/category/lesson IDs.

proof_field_semantics.asset_persisted: Asset bytes exist at a durable location and match the manifest sha256/byte_size. A permanent video URL alone proves only this field.
proof_field_semantics.native_content_ready: GHL reports the native course content object of the right type exists and finished processing.
proof_field_semantics.lesson_association_verified: A readback shows the lesson is associated with that native content id.
proof_field_semantics.learner_render_verified: A learner-context render observed the content. An administrator preview does NOT prove this.

seam_functions.inspect_asset: inspect_asset(path, expected_mime=None) -> dict  # sha256, byte_size, mime_type, magic_verified
seam_functions.validate_asset_manifest: validate_asset_manifest(manifest, paid_course=True) -> dict  # normalized manifest; raises AssetValidationError
seam_functions.select_binding_path: select_binding_path(asset=..., native_content=..., import_supported=..., course_is_new=..., hierarchy_created_by_api=..., public_ingest_available=...) -> dict  # {path, rationale, requires_managed_browser, mixed_import_refused}
seam_functions.attach_existing_native_content: attach_existing_native_content(client, location_id=, course_id=, lesson_id=, content_id=, content_type=, asset=None) -> dict  # adapter protocol: attach_lesson_content, read_lesson
seam_functions.submit_course_import: submit_course_import(client, location_id=, payload=) -> dict  # never reports a completed course
seam_functions.poll_processing: poll_processing(poll, state=None, deadline_s=300, interval_s=5, clock=, sleep=, max_polls=60) -> dict  # bounded + resumable
seam_functions.apply_managed_ui_binding: apply_managed_ui_binding(steps, actions, asset=) -> dict  # readback required
seam_functions.native_course_upload_exception: native_course_upload_exception(purpose=, public_ingest_available=, asset=) -> dict  # narrow, never general media

notes: Selector fragments and selector JSON are owned by WF09; this contract only names the keys WF08 needs.
No HTTP method, path or Version literal is frozen here: WF06 owns the operation rows.
A processing state is never reported as a completed course (acceptance A11).
